desc: Implement the solution reading T test cases.
For each case, extract positions of 1s in A and B.
Implement binary search for minimum $K$ in range $[0, 2 \cdot 10^6]$.
Implement the `check(K)` function with greedy strategy.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Check edge cases (e.g., $N=1$, all 0s or all 1s, impossible cases).
Ensure input reading handles large inputs efficiently (using `sys.stdin.read`).
